crossRefs.note: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said, “I will go now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burned.”
translations.bsb: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
translations.kjv: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
translations.asv: And Moses said, I will turn aside now, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
